cases.prompt: Run $ccgs-brainstorm in English for the already-approved Pocket Courier toy-game MVP. Requirements are complete, so do not ask a creative follow-up: one small Godot game supports left/right movement, wall collision, collecting exactly three targets, and restart after a run; explicitly exclude online play and networking. Use minimal rigor with guided automation and write design/game-brief.md. Its Build order must be actionable for these behaviors and Out of Scope must preserve the no-online boundary. Do not claim a playable run, screenshot, or implementation was tested.

Run $ccgs-map-systems in English against the approved design/gdd/game-concept.md for Pocket Courier. Resolve standard/guided Godot configuration, preserve the accepted scope, and write design/gdd/systems-index.md with exactly two MVP systems: Movement as Foundation and Collection as Core depending on Movement. Do not infer UI, networking, persistence, or any other systems; online play is out of scope. Use the fixed systems-index table and valid registry layout, report dependency order and registry validation, and do not claim runtime execution.

Run $ccgs-create-epics in English for accepted Pocket Courier design. Resolve standard/guided Godot configuration, read approved Movement and Collection GDDs, architecture modules, accepted ADR-0001, and valid TR registry. Create exactly two epics at production/epics/movement/EPIC.md and production/epics/collection/EPIC.md plus their index rows. Preserve TR-MOVEMENT-001 and TR-COLLECTION-001 coverage, name the correct modules and accepted ADR, and do not invent stories or systems. The user approved writing these epics; do not claim implementation or runtime validation.

Run $ccgs-sprint-plan new in English for Pocket Courier. Resolve standard/guided Godot configuration and use user-approved capacity of 10 days. Plan sprint 001 with dependency-ordered Ready stories 1-1 Movement foundation (3 days), 1-2 Wall collision (3 days), and 1-3 Collect three targets (4 days), total 10. Keep blocked 1-4 Online mode (4 days) out, and do not invent velocity, story, QA result, or current-game execution. Write production/sprints/sprint-001.md and production/sprint-status.yaml with the three ready-for-dev stories, real paths, estimates, and honest blocked-scope note.
